recognize_zh: 一顆巨大的巨噬細胞，細胞質內塞滿被吞噬的中性球、單核細胞核與紅血球（部分位於空泡內），這就是噬血現象（hemophagocytosis），可見於續發性噬血症候群。
features: Very large macrophage with abundant pale vacuolated cytoplasm
Multiple engulfed intact nucleated cells, including segmented neutrophils and mononuclear cells, within phagocytic vacuoles
Several engulfed red cells and red-cell fragments in the cytoplasm
Macrophage's own nucleus obscured by ingested material
Background of hematopoietic cells and red cells in an aspirate smear
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large macrophage whose cytoplasm contains numerous phagocytosed hematopoietic elements, including several segmented neutrophils, mononuclear nucleated cells and red cells, many within clear vacuoles. Surrounding marrow cells are unremarkable in this field. Findings demonstrate hemophagocytosis and, in the appropriate clinical and laboratory setting, are consistent with hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis; hemophagocytosis alone is not diagnostic of HLH.

ddx.vs: Tingible body macrophages contain apoptotic nuclear debris rather than intact neutrophils, nucleated cells and red cells.
Emperipolesis shows intact cells passing through a megakaryocyte with a large lobulated nucleus and granular cytoplasm, not phagolysosomal digestion in a macrophage.
Rosai-Dorfman histiocytes are S100-positive and contain intact lymphocytes and plasma cells, typically in lymph nodes rather than a marrow aspirate.
